payment.question: When do I pay?
payment.answer: You pay when you book. Your helper is paid after the task is done. The task price, service fee, and full total are shown before you confirm.

address.question: Who can see my address?
address.answer: Helpers see only the general area. Your exact address is shared with your helper after you book.

account.question: Can I get help and be a helper?
account.answer: Yes. One account has both modes: “I need help” and “I can help.” Set up your helper profile when you're ready to offer your skills.

rebook.question: Can I book the same helper again?
rebook.answer: Yes. Save a helper you trust, then use Book again in two taps. You agree on the task, time, and price for each booking.

closing.eyebrow: One less thing on your list
closing.title: What could you use a hand with?
closing.body: Start with one task. Find a little more time for you.
